description: Erection of single storey rear, first floor side infill incorporating alterations to the roof of the existing side extension and part first floor rear extensions to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Fire safety plan, Dwg No 80/P/01, Dwg No 80/P/02, Dwg No 80/P/03, Dwg 80/P/04, Dwg 80/P/05, Dwg 80/P/06, Dwg 80/P/07 received 16/11/2023].

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), [no additional windows shall be inserted in any part of the development] [and] [no additional dormer windows] shall be constructed.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
